# Views a tapir agent can drive

A view's primary flows (form submit, list action, navigation) have to be reachable by `tapir` through a semantic label or a widget key, on top of passing tests.

- Give every icon-only or ambiguous interactive widget a label: `WButton(semanticLabel: 'Edit user ${user.name}')`. An icon-only `WButton` has no text child for the Semantics tree to absorb, so without a label it cannot be found by label. For a widget with no `semanticLabel` parameter, wrap it in `Semantics(label: '...', child: widget)`.
- Give an interactive widget a `ValueKey` when it is rendered conditionally or inside a list: `ValueKey('delete-item-${item.id}')`. `tapir:find --key` is its most precise predicate and survives label and copy changes, which a label match does not.
- Drive a submit button's loading state with `MagicBuilder<bool>(listenable: form.processingListenable, ...)` feeding `WButton(isLoading: ...)`, not a `setState` on the view. Only the button subtree rebuilds, and `isLoading` makes `WButton` ignore taps, so a second tap cannot reach `form.process`, which throws a `StateError` mid-flight.
